# rustinion_permission_role_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a rustinion_permission_role to a user, optionally scoped to one group. The user must already hold a role in the tenant — an assignment refines access, it never confers membership. Has no in-place update: an assignment is its (role, user, scope) tuple, so changing any attribute replaces it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) The role being assigned (`rustinion_permission_role.example.id`).
- `user_id` (String) The user receiving it (`users.id`). Reference `rustinion_user.example.user_id` — **not** that resource's `id`, which is its `user_roles` row id.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Scope the assignment to one group. Omit for a tenant-wide assignment covering every group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned assignment ID.
